code:
This project replaced a shared-login, no-governance claims
setup with real clinic-based access control, and found and
fixed a real bug that had been understating a billing total.

It did not add alerting beyond a weekly dashboard, an
automated check on clinic assignments, or a governance gate
on new columns -- named gaps for a future phase, not
oversights we're pretending don't exist.
caption: Not every problem solved -- every remaining one named, owned, and handed off.
